Their opponents also qualified for the finals and they begin their tournament two days earlier against Iran. These teams last met back in 1991, when England prevailed 1-0 in Auckland and 2-0 in Wellington. With analysis from Roy Keane and Karen Carney, pitchside inserts from Ian Wright and Gabriel Clarke, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon
